author: (R. A. Philippi, 1853)

note.en: A pheasant snail under 4 mm that grazes on seagrass blades and algae. Collected at Punta Mona, Punta Uva and Cahuita (1998 to 2003). Too small to notice.
note.es: Un caracol faisán de menos de 4 mm que ramonea hojas de pasto marino y algas. Recolectado en Punta Mona, Punta Uva y Cahuita (1998 a 2003). Demasiado pequeño para notarlo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)

recWhy: Collected at Punta Mona, Punta Uva and Cahuita.
